decisions: | D3 Reads | answered | **Vex entries**, read by an action by its fingerprint (`/api/vex`), under the person's policy. None yet: the tour the app starts with is text in its actions. |
| D4 Writes | answered | **Vex mutation entries**, posted to `/api/vex` by a form the person saves, never by the model. None yet. |

| D6 Who answers a message | answered | Jev reads the message and the open screen (`TYPESAFE_API_KEY`), then gpt-oss-120b on Groq composes the screen as a cortex agent (`GROQ_API_KEY`), with what Jev picked as a hint. Without a TypeSafe key there is no Jev pass. Jev may take 2 s and the model 8 s; past that, the model answers alone, or the line says it could not be reached and the screen stays as it is. Measured on the tour's cases (`src/dev/live-ask.ts --runs=2`): 30/32 right with Jev, 31/32 without, and about 200 ms slower with it. |

| D7 What a screen is made of | answered | Canvases: an action the model may place (`placeable`, in `src/app/action-catalog.ts`), opened with an input its schema takes, and why it is there; or words. Up to six, on the areas `a`–`f`; the screens in the dock are canvases too (`src/app/screens.ts`). |

| D8 History | derived · **open** | The answers one shell was given, kept while it lives; a reload starts again. An answer keeps what the person did on it when it is left — a count, a step ticked, a pick — as a browser keeps a page's form, so going back shows it as they left it. Open: whether a person's answers outlive the shell, and memory beyond that. |

| D9 Layout swaps | derived · **open: sign-in** | An answer’s arrangement is swapped into the frame’s `answers` region through moss’s unverified shell (`@niscorp/moss/unverified`, in `src/server/compose/index.ts`), because moss lets a session change a layout only through a draft, and a draft needs a signed-in person. **When the app has sign-in, the swap moves to `session.draft`, where moss checks it.** |

| D10 What keeps a canvas in place | answered | **The model answers by area.** It names only the areas that change — a canvas moved from another area, a new one, words, or nothing — and an area it leaves out stays as it is, the same canvas: a card filled in never moves the others. |
| D11 Jev's "still wanted?" | answered | **Not asked.** On ten follow-ups Jev was right 8 of 14 times, and with its answer the model dropped what was open. |

| D12 What a card written onto a screen keeps | derived | **Nothing of what was there.** A canvas the model or a screen writes holds its whole input: what it leaves out is its action's default, so a checklist written where another was shows none of its ticks, and a new quick check opens unpicked. A canvas an answer leaves alone keeps what the person did to it. |
answered: **Who leads:** a model. A message is answered with a screen: Jev reads the message and the open screen, gpt-oss-120b composes the screen from the app's actions, and the dock places it on the six areas. The keys are in `.env`.
open: The entities, and how they relate — and what a person will ask about them.
Who uses it: one person, or roles. More than one principal sketches its roles and charter now, not later.
Memory: what the app keeps of a person between messages.
What happens to the data long-term.
order: **The interview** — every open item above, answered or delegated by name. ← here

**Scaffold** — done: the frame, the message loop, the dock, a tour of nisc in five screens — cards to read, and a counter, a checklist and a quick check to use, which the model can fill in too — and their checks.
**Data** — the tour goes first (AGENTS.md, "How to proceed from here"); then, per D2/D3, your tables in `src/db/schema.ts`, your reads in `src/app/vex/`.

**Actions** — your own, small: one purpose each, a description that says what it shows, an `input` schema for what the model fills in; the ones the model may place in `placeable`, each granted in the charter.
**Screens** — the ones a person will want in the dock, each its canvases; the first the one the app opens on.
**Writes** — per D4; a form an answer opens, filled in by the model, saved by the person.

**Checks** — a check for each feature in `src/dev/`, beside `compose-check.ts`, which runs the loop offline; and `live-ask` cases for what people will ask, run against the real models before a change to an action's description or to the instructions is kept.
